column4: S4.2b: the one stack (SndFrame). A port function's frame is modelled only where the original passes a local's address (the 14 bodies of S4.4 / S4.6 / S4.8 that do, at the original's offsets read from the instructions; `and esp, -8` frames through set_esp); every other port function's esp at a call is its entry esp, so a port callee it dispatches to enters a few bytes above the original's callee (the caller's saved registers and pushed temporaries are not reserved). No judged key compares such an address: every by-address local whose callee is a port function sits in a body whose frame IS modelled. The host's calls run with the emulator's esp 0x400 below the entry esp (native_call adds 0x400 more), and port frames are refused below entry - 0x700 (sound_replay FRAME_LIMIT): host-run callees do not build their frames at the original's addresses (as before S4.2b). Production has no entry esp: frames go to the frame block 0xFEB00000 (64 KB, entry = top - 0x44), a chosen address.
column5: S4.10: the exe's sound layer gives a real entry esp (or keeps the block) and reserves full frames if a caller of a by-address function is ever judged on addresses; a host esp from the core (a C ABI field) if a host-run callee's own locals are ever compared.

column4: S4.2b: the x87 unit as the core FPU model. (a) A host call sees the unit through the box page kSndFpuBox (0xFEAF0000) when the harness maps it: the image goes in before the call and comes back after it; a host call that returns st(0) (want_st0) gets its value as a double in the reply and the core does NOT push it on the unit (no port function makes such a call). (b) fyl2x is the reference emulator's (Unicorn 2.1.4: operands rounded to double by the rounding control, C log / log(2) and the product in double, back exactly), equal to Unicorn on 3,000 probe records at eight control words (test_x87_fyl2x_equals_the_emulator) and on the 69,680-call setVolume grid; the CPU's fyl2x is not modelled (U-1471). (c) The exit state compared per vector is the control word, TOP, C0..C3 and the registers in use; exception flags are not (U-1407), nor C1 after loads and stores. (d) The S4.6 bodies that compared doubles in C now compare on the unit (Channel_releaseVoices, Channel_stopVoices, updateVoiceRate, Channel_startVoice, Voice_setPanGains, Voice_noteOff: log/roadmap/S4/2b_x87scan.tsv); value-style helpers keep intermediate values off the unit's register stack, so a callee the original calls with a value pushed (Voice::update's K across its calls, the rate step's q across __ftol) sees one register fewer in use: no callee reads the stack depth in any judged key. (e) Phase 2: bodies whose compares are C comparisons (every S4.3 codec body, CxScope) mark C0..C3 unknown (Unit::cc_unmodelled, image flag bit 0 at offset 10; the next modelled compare or fninit clears it), and the harness does not compare C0..C3 for those vectors (626 of S4.3's 628); every other module's compares now set them on the unit (S4.9 openMmioSound 0x3096a / 0x30982, closeMmioSound 0x35db3 / 0x35dc6; writeWaveChunk / B run the original's six fninit), so a later port of the codec onto the unit can drop the flag.
column5: S4.10 / a later step: push st(0) results of host calls on the unit if a port function ever calls an x87-returning callee through the host; transcribe Voice::update's resident K on the unit if a callee that depends on the stack depth is ported.
